name: Morton Code Encoding/Decoding
definition: A method to encode multidimensional data (XYZ 3D grid coordinates) into a one-dimensional array (Morton code) to preserve data locality. It uses bit interleaving of the X, Y, and Z coordinates.
summary: Morton Code Encoding/Decoding converts N-dimensional coordinates into a 1D index by interleaving bits to preserve spatial locality, distinguishing itself from Hilbert encoding via simpler bitwise operations.
